messages:
Luis (AcmeCorp): Heads up - after today's rollout our integrator is getting different outputs for the same request within the same session. This is breaking reconciliation.
Alex (Support): Sorry to hear that. Can you paste the exact prompt and both responses? Any response headers (x-request-id / x-redwood-served-variant) would help.
Luis (AcmeCorp): Prompt: "Translate product code ACME-P420 to canonical SKU and unit_price." Two consecutive calls with identical payload. Response 1: "SKU: ACME-420-L, price: $19.99" Response 2: "Unknown SKU maybe 421? price TBD" Headers: x-request-id: r-9f001, r-9f002. x-redwood-served-variant: redwood-3b-v3 / redwood-3b-compat-v2
Alex (Support): tagging @jamal_engineer @sophie_ml to investigate routing/variant differences.
jamal_engineer: looking into logs now.
customer_acct_bot: Customer AcmeCorp | plan: enterprise | tenancy: dedicated | region: us-west-2
runtime-bot: Noted. Canary rollout for redwood-3b-v3 started 2026-03-09T14:12:03Z in us-west-2.
jamal_engineer: I can confirm two different served variants. r-9f001 -> redwood-3b-v3, r-9f002 -> redwood-3b-compat-v2. r-9f002 shows runtime event: "kv-cache-evict, mem-pressure" and then fallback to compat-v2.
sophie_ml: compat-v2 has slightly different tokenization and decoding defaults (nucleus/p) compared to v3. That could explain hallucinated SKU in second response.
Alex (Support): Is it expected behavior that fallback can change semantics this much?
jamal_engineer: Not ideal. Fallback is supposed to be functionally compatible but config drift exists between variants. Also autoscaler didn't add capacity quick enough for the burst.
Luis (AcmeCorp): What's a viable mitigation? We need deterministic outputs for our reconciliation logic.
sophie_ml: Short-term: you can pin to a specific model variant by adding query param model=redwood-3b-v3 or tenant-level pin. We'll also align decoding defaults across variants so fallbacks match semantics.
Alex (Support): I'll open an internal escalation and request tenant-pin for AcmeCorp while we fix this. Also suggest customer set temperature=0 for deterministic mapping until stable.
Maria (Product): Acknowledged. I'll coordinate with infra to pause the canary for redwood-3b-v3 in us-west-2 for this tenant and request capacity increase if needed.
jamal_engineer: Repro checklist for engineering (from Luis): 1) use customer's API key 2) POST /v1/generate with exact prompt twice back-to-back 3) include header x-customer-tenant: acmecorp 4) capture x-request-id and x-redwood-served-variant and runtime mem stats
Alex (Support): Created ticket INC-4021 to pause canary for affected tenant and INF-3010 to track runtime autoscale tweaks. ML config sync tracked under ML-209.
jamal_engineer: I reproduced locally by applying mem stress to a node; when KV cache reached threshold runtime evicted and requests routed to compat-v2. Autoscale delay was ~12s which is within thresholds but too slow for short bursts.
sophie_ml: Proposed fixes: 1) sync tokenizer and decoding defaults across compat/v3 families 2) add guardrails so fallback variant loads same model vocab/tokenizer 3) tune autoscaler to detect KV pressure earlier.
Alex (Support): Action items:
- [jamal_engineer] INF-3010: Runtime autoscale tune + faster instance spin (ETA: 24-48h)
- [sophie_ml] ML-209: Sync tokenizer/decoding defaults across variants (ETA: 2-3 days)
- [Maria (Product)] INC-4021: Pause canary or apply tenant pin in us-west-2 for acmecorp (in progress)
- [Alex (Support)] Notify customer and confirm tenant pin is applied
Luis (AcmeCorp): Please also ensure the x-redwood-served-variant header includes full variant id. That helped a lot.
Alex (Support): Will do. We'll make sure x-redwood-served-variant and x-redwood-request-id are present in responses going forward. :thumbsup:
jamal_engineer: Adding detailed logs and r-9f001/r-9f002 payloads to INF-3010. Will draft a quick mitigation patch to prefer pinned variant for dedicated tenants while autoscale catches up.
sophie_ml: Adding regression test to eval suite specifically for "product code -> SKU mapping" prompt to catch regressions if fallback changes output.
Alex (Support): We'll keep this channel updated. Keeping INC-4021 open until tenant pin + autoscale tuning deployed.
Luis (AcmeCorp): Thanks all. Appreciate the quick triage. We'll standby for ETA and confirm once tenant pin is active. :pray:
